scope: Pediatric CKD-associated growth disorder, explicit initiation, identified somatropin, service date>=2024-05-17. No initiation growth predicates applied to continuation.

hints.ckd_height_age_sex_percentile: Recorded height percentile adjusted for age and sex. No conversion from centimetres or SDS.
hints.ckd_height_age_sex_sds: Recorded age/sex-adjusted height SD score, finite signed. No conversion from percentile. Source notation agreement requires review when discordant or only one reference is recorded; both tests are not claimed legally mandatory.
hints.ckd_annual_growth_velocity_percentile: Recorded annual growth velocity percentile, not centimetres/year or calculated from diagnosis.
hints.ckd_persistent_growth_failure_confirmed: Recorded persistent growth failure assessment, never inferred from a single low measurement.
hints.ckd_post_transplant_one_year_elapsed: Recorded source-defined completed post-transplant year assessment; no anniversary calculation or inference from first-year=false.
hints.ckd_steroid_treatment_absent: Recorded absence of steroid treatment in the post-transplant source branch.
hints.ckd_spontaneous_growth_absent: Recorded absence of spontaneous growth in the post-transplant source branch.
hints.ckd_nephropathic_cystinosis_related_conf: Confirmed CKD related to nephropathic cystinosis, not inferred from a broad kidney diagnosis.
